---
title: Main-text figure and table plan
---

This is a publication planning document. It identifies the role of each
display; it does not select final results, change estimates, or approve a new
fuel analysis.

## Main-text figures

| Working figure | Purpose in manuscript | Thesis source | Publication action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Study design | Orient readers to the Jackson Demonstration State Forest study area and treatment/sampling layout. | `analysis/thesis/methods.qmd`, Figures 2.1–2.2 | Retain one clear design figure; consider moving the second map/layout figure to supplement if the combined design can remain legible. |
| Regeneration response | Show redwood and tanoak understory density/basal-area response to overstory retention. | `fig-regen-ba-rw-to` in `analysis/thesis/results.qmd` | Retain and simplify as the lead results figure; omit secondary species classes from the main figure unless essential. |
| Sprout development | Show treatment and/or time pattern in redwood and tanoak sprout height. | `fig-sprout-ht-inc-treat`, `fig-sprout-ht-inc-year`, `fig-sprout-ht-yr-10` | Combine only if the resulting display answers one management question; otherwise retain the clearest single response figure and move the others to supplement. |
| Fuel reference profile | Report disaggregated fuel components at the measurement phases relevant to fire-modeling use. | `fig-fuel-pre-pct`, `fig-fuel-post-pct`, `fig-fuel-pct-comparison` | Replace after the publication-specific component specification and model/summarization review. Emphasize values and uncertainty; show treatment comparisons only when interpretively useful. |
| Optional thinning context | Show the before/after context if it materially clarifies fuel conditions after precommercial thinning. | `fig-fuel-pct-comparison` | Include only if it remains central after fuel reanalysis; otherwise place in supplement. |

The working target is four main-text figures, with a fifth only if the
precommercial-thinning comparison is necessary to understand the reference
conditions.

## Main-text tables

| Working table | Purpose in manuscript | Thesis source | Publication action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Treatment and sampling design | Give treatment labels, retained-overstory targets, plot replication, and measurement timing. | `analysis/thesis/methods.qmd` | Create a compact new table; do not reproduce procedural detail already visible in the design figure. |
| Regeneration summary | Provide the small set of estimated values needed to support the lead regeneration figure. | `tbl-regen-ba-grand-means`, sprout tables in `analysis/thesis/tables.qmd` | Create only if figure annotations cannot communicate the estimates adequately. |
| Fuel reference values | Provide disaggregated fuel-component values, units, phase, and uncertainty for reuse by other studies. | Fuel mean and grand-mean tables in `analysis/thesis/tables.qmd` | Create after the publication-specific fuel definitions and summaries are finalized. |

## Supplementary displays

The supplement is the default location for the current detailed model listings,
dispersion/hurdle specifications, full pairwise-comparison tables, Douglas-fir
detail, secondary sprout figures, and expanded pre/post fuel comparisons. This
preserves reproducibility without requiring each item to carry the main
silvicultural narrative.
